title: Smarter Semester Coach
notes: New: Private, on-device grade coaching for every course.
New: Identifies the weakest grade category and recommends a concrete next study step.
New: Shows a one-result or two-result path toward the target grade.
Improved: Recent grade direction appears only when enough results support it.
Improved: Every insight states how much evidence it uses.
Privacy: Coach analysis stays on the phone and does not use a cloud AI service.
